notes: Zaoran Plateau's three factions as questmasters1.com's guide (2006-07, the 2007 pages of Cryptic Souls and BlackPearl it carries) has them, beside #494 (jibrish's 2008-2012 plateau, which stands): the Soldiers of Rallos Zek, Mithaniel Marr's Crusaders and the Akessan Collective, their camps, introductory and alignment quests, the faction turn-ins and the Master Spellsmiths' abilities, the camps' named and their drops. Spots, counts, levels and figures ours; see tools/quests/data/zp-factions.json's notes.
